description: An oil-painted interior of a rustic stone-hearthed cottage at night, lit by a glowing fire. An elderly grey-haired woman in a dark dress sits on the left, gesturing with open hands toward two young men in dark 19th-century frock coats and white collars. The man on the right writes with a quill on paper at a small wooden table, while the other leans in and listens. Copper and brass pots hang on the wall, and a spinning wheel stands at the right. No letters, numbers or signature are visible, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame or border.
